searchText: how probable you guys think it is that Forsage will grow big enough to warrant an irregular state change? What would be a plausible irregular state change? Imo things like regenesis or stateless ethereum would make projects like Forsage more maneagable. I'm (for now, lol) less worried about state bloat and more worried about the gas space that autonomous ponzis will/do take up on a regular basis. I don't know what wold be plausible, it depends on how severe the situation is.
